from solution import count_samepair


def test_issue_example():
    """Example from issue: count_samepair([1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8],...)==3."""
    assert count_samepair([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8], [2, 2, 3, 1, 2, 6, 7, 9], [2, 1, 3, 1, 2, 6, 7, 9]) == 3  # 1+1+1=3 matches at indices 2,5,6


def test_issue_empty_lists():
    """Edge case: count the same pair in three empty lists is zero."""
    assert count_samepair([], [], []) == 0  # 0+0=0 matches


def test_issue_all_positions_match():
    """Rule: count positions where all three lists have the same value."""
    assert count_samepair([4, 5, 6], [4, 5, 6], [4, 5, 6]) == 3  # 1+1+1=3 matches


def test_issue_no_positions_match():
    """Rule: count positions where all three lists have the same value."""
    assert count_samepair([1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6], [7, 8, 9]) == 0  # 0+0+0=0 matches


def test_issue_single_element_match():
    """Rule: count positions where all three lists have the same value."""
    assert count_samepair([5], [5], [5]) == 1  # 0+1=1 match


def test_issue_single_element_mismatch():
    """Rule: count positions where all three lists have the same value."""
    assert count_samepair([1], [2], [3]) == 0  # 0+0=0 matches


def test_issue_only_first_two_equal():
    """Rule: a position counts only if all three lists match, not just two."""
    assert count_samepair([1, 2], [1, 2], [1, 9]) == 1  # 1+0=1 triple match only at index 0


def test_issue_only_last_two_equal():
    """Rule: a position counts only if all three lists match, not just two."""
    assert count_samepair([1, 2], [9, 2], [9, 2]) == 1  # 0+1=1 triple match only at index 1


def test_issue_only_first_and_third_equal():
    """Rule: a position counts only if all three lists match, not just two."""
    assert count_samepair([7], [8], [7]) == 0  # 0+0=0 triple matches


def test_issue_mixed_multiple_matches():
    """Rule: count positions where all three lists have the same value."""
    assert count_samepair([1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 9, 3, 9], [1, 2, 3, 9]) == 2  # 1+0+1+0=2 matches at indices 0,2


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Contract: count_samepair(list1, list2, list3) returns a count."""
    result = count_samepair([1, 2], [1, 2], [1, 2])  # 1+1=2 matches
    assert isinstance(result, int)


def test_contract_inputs_unchanged():
    """Contract: count_samepair(list1, list2, list3) takes three lists without mutating them."""
    a = [1, 2, 3]  # 1+1+1=3 elements
    b = [1, 9, 3]  # 1+1+1=3 elements
    c = [1, 2, 3]  # 1+1+1=3 elements
    count_samepair(a, b, c)
    assert (a, b, c) == ([1, 2, 3], [1, 9, 3], [1, 2, 3])
